verses.gurmukhi: ਕੰਮ ਕਿਤੈ ਪਿਉ ਚਲਿਆ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਨੋ ਆਖਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: ka(n)m kitai piau chaliaa naamadheau no aakh sidhaiaa|

en.bdb: Namdev's father was called to do some work so he called Naamdev.

verses.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਦੁਧੁ ਪੀਆਵਣੁ ਕਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: Thaakur dhee sevaa karee dhudh peeaavan keh samajhaiaa|

en.bdb: He told Namdev to serve Thakur, the Lord, with milk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਪਲ ਗਾਇ ਦੁਹਿ ਕੈ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: naamadheau isanaan kar kapal gai dhuh kai lai aaiaa|

en.bdb: After taking bath Namdev brought the milk of black-teat cow.

verses.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨੋ ਨ੍ਹਾਵਾਲਿ ਕੈ ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਲੈ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: Thaakur no nhaavaal kai charanodhak lai tilak chaRhaiaa|

en.bdb: Having bathed the Thakur, he put the water used to wash the Thakur, on his own head.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਥਿ ਜੋੜਿ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰੈ ਦੁਧੁ ਪੀਅਹੁ ਜੀ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: hath joR binatee karai dhudh peeahu jee gobi(n)dh raiaa|

en.bdb: Now with folded hands he requested the Lord to have milk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਉ ਕਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: nihachau kar aaraadhiaa hoi dhiaal dharas dhikhalaiaa|

en.bdb: Becoming steadfast in his thoughts when he prayed, the Lord appeared before him in person.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਰੀ ਕਟੋਰੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਵਿ ਲੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨੋ ਦੁਧੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bharee kaToree naamadhev lai Thaakur no dhudh peeaaiaa|

en.bdb: Namdev made Lord drink the full bowl of milk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਇ ਮੁਈ ਜੀਵਾਲਿਓਨੁ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਦਾ ਛਪਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gai muiee jeevaalion naamadhev dhaa chhapar chhaiaa|

en.bdb: On another occasion God brought a dead cow to life and also thatched the hut of Namdev.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫੇਰਿ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਲੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: fer dhehuraa rakhion chaar varan lai pairee paiaa|

en.bdb: On yet another occasion, God rotated the temple (after Naamdev was not allowed entrance) and made all the four castes (varnas) bow at the feet of Namdev.
The Lord accomplishes whatever is done and desired by saints.
